node_definition.done_when: Done when a new tests/test_a_run_leaves_nothing_behind.py shows, with a temporary repository and crew home: a landed run, a discarded run and a promoted run with nothing to merge each end with no worktree registered or on disk, no scratch, and no run directory left under the walked runs tree, with the archive record present; a run that is blocked or awaiting resume keeps its worktree and directory; a crash between ending and cleanup is cleaned by the next sweep pass, which prints every path it removes; and a gc pass over a crew home holding 200 ended runs and 5 live ones touches only the 5 live runs' paths. The worker also records, on the live fleet, the worktree and run-directory counts before and after one backstop sweep at the head, run in bounded slices with every removal printed, and the gc dry-run time on the reckon repository after it. Negative control: skipping the end-of-life cleanup in the landing leaves the landed run's worktree on disk, and the test must fail. The test files importing the gc, landing and discard modules add no failure against the base revision, measured on all_debug one arm at a time with at most -n 4. Ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings on the staged paths. Write paths: reckon/crew, the new test, and the section's evidence fragment.
